title: register new user with valid data
description: Test the /api/register endpoint to ensure a new user can be registered successfully with valid email, name, and password.

title: get authenticated user data
description: Test the /api/auth/user/route.ts GET endpoint to verify it returns the authenticated user's data correctly.

title: update user profile with valid fields
description: Test the /api/profile PUT endpoint to update user profile fields including name, address, license type, and license image, and verify successful update.

title: get user profile by user id
description: Test the /api/profile/{userId} GET endpoint to retrieve the profile information for a given user ID.

title: create new vehicle listing with complete data
description: Test the /api/listings POST endpoint to create a new vehicle listing with all required fields including title, description, images, category, specifications, location, and registration details.

title: get vehicle listing by listing id
description: Test the /api/listings/{listingId} GET endpoint to retrieve vehicle listing details by its ID.

title: update vehicle listing by listing id
description: Test the /api/listings/{listingId} PUT endpoint to update details of an existing vehicle listing identified by listing ID.

title: create new reservation with insurance and pricing
description: Test the /api/reservations POST endpoint to create a new reservation including listing ID, start and end dates, total price, insurance type, and insurance fee.

title: get all reservations for user
description: Test the /api/reservations GET endpoint to retrieve all reservations for the authenticated user.

title: update reservation status
description: Test the /api/reservations/{reservationId} PUT endpoint to update the status of a reservation identified by reservation ID.
